flags.catalogue.title: Asset flags
flags.catalogue.text: Status facts analysts set on case assets: isolated, credentials reset, restored... Unlike tags they are a managed list - an administrator defines each flag here (name, colour, icon, kind) - and every change is recorded in the asset's history and the case log. The order here is the order everywhere.

flags.kind.title: Flag kind
flags.kind.text: What a flag means for the war-room Board.

items.name: Status
items.text: A fact about the asset (isolated, credentials reset...).

items.name: Done
items.text: Nothing left to do on the asset. The Board counts it as done.

items.name: Exception
items.text: An accepted gap. The Board lists it under Needs attention.

flags.requires_reason.title: Requires a reason
flags.requires_reason.text: Setting this flag on an asset, or removing it, asks for a written reason, kept in the asset's flag history.

flags.requires_decision.title: Requires a decision
flags.requires_decision.text: Setting this flag must cite an approved decision of a war room the case is attached to - one deciding for the whole room, for that case or for that asset (risk acceptance, for example). You choose among the decisions of rooms you belong to; a decision a flag cites cannot be deleted.

flags.preset.title: Load preset
flags.preset.text: Adds a ready-made set of flags - Incident response or Vulnerability. Only the flags whose name is not taken yet are added; nothing existing is changed or removed.

flags.asset.title: Flags of this asset
flags.asset.text: The status flags set on this asset. + Flag sets one, the cross removes it (a flag that requires a reason asks for one). The change count opens the asset's flag history. Changing flags needs full access to the case; the list of flags is managed in Settings > Asset flags.

flags.history.title: Flag history
flags.history.text: Every flag set, updated (new reason or decision) or removed on this asset: when (UTC), by whom, the reason and the decision cited. It keeps a flag's name even after the flag is deleted.

flags.filter.title: Flag filter
flags.filter.text: Shows only the assets carrying the chosen flag, or the ones carrying no flag at all.
